lines: Every night at three oh seven, something knocks on my door.
I live alone on the fourteenth floor. Nobody else lives down my hall.
Last night, I looked through the peephole.
The hallway looked empty. Then the light flickered, and something tall was standing at the far end.
The light flickered again. It was halfway down the hall.
Its head was bent against the ceiling. Its fingers hung down to its knees.
I stepped back. Then the knocking started again. Three slow knocks.
They were coming from my closet.
The thing outside was never trying to get in.
It was trying to tell me I wasn't alone.
